prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for home flow changes (home, new_flow) and path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) because each has only 1 test so far.
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no tests have resulted in a statistically significant win.
No clear effect was seen for new home flows (home, new_flow) or path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign).
Predictions were generally too optimistic and too high, especially for sign-in reordering where a +20.0% gain was predicted but resulted in a loss.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Overview and Behavior Preview Screen: Adds a brief desktop pet behavior overview screen right before the waiting phase to explain desktop placement and interaction. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or interact with the pet, and home step has a long mean time of 2336s.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Checklist Home Intro Redesign: Redesigns the final home_intro screen into a clear checklist layout detailing core desktop controls before user completes onboarding. (why: Support mailbox received multiple messages from confused users unsure of how to hide, summon, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Prologue Introduction Story Flow: Introduces an engaging prologue screen before path selection to frame pet companion options clearly. (why: Choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating initial hesitation or confusion when deciding how to begin.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Split Layout Redesign: Redesigns photo upload screen into a two-column split layout pairing lighting sample photos with the photo selection dropzone. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate before final steps (60.9%) and support received reports of custom pet generation failing.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Time Transparency Status: Enables progress indicator, time estimates, and system notifications on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty during generation.)
5: [adoption, hint] Preset Companion Instant Load Hint: Adds an instant load badge and helpful hint on preset pet selection to clarify immediate availability. (why: Adoption step drop-off is 39.1% (60.9% conversion); highlighting quick preset options reduces effort for users in a rush.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selector Centered Compact Layout: Switches the choose_path screen layout to a centered compact structure for faster visual decision making. (why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean time is 514s, indicating visual friction for a subset of users.)
7: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Connection Troubleshooting Notification: Displays a subtle diagnostic tip on the sign-in screen to help users if the authentication window stalls. (why: 2 support emails specifically mentioned the sign-in screen failing to appear or stalling before loading.)

scores.note: Adds a new screen to clarify home step; supported by 3 support emails and 2336s mean time.
Redesigns finish screen to address post-setup control confusion reported in support mails.
Adds new prologue screen for choose_path based only on mean time funnel metric.
Targets lowest-converting step (60.9%) backed by both funnel drop-off and support ticket reports.
Addresses high waiting step mean time (2336s) by providing progress notifications.
Simple badge/hint on high drop-off adoption step, low effort implementation.
Compact layout tweak for choose_path to address long mean duration; prior test had weak positive lift.
Troubleshooting tip for sign-in step backed by 2 emails, but sign-in historical tests showed negative lift.
